paite: "Hiai bang in Bezaleel, Aholiab leh mun siangthou vanzatte bawldan ding thei ding a TOUPA'N pilna leh theihsiamna a piak khutsiamte'n TOUPA thupiak bang in vanzatte abawl ding uh ahi,” achi hi.
Huai khit in Mosi in Bezaleel, Aholiab leh michih khutsiamna nei, alungtang ua TOUPA'N pilna akoih leh michih alungtang ua nasem a kuan dia tohthoh a omte Mosi in asamta hi.
heading: Mite'n Thilpiak Tampi Atawi Uh

paite: Amaute'n mun siangthou bawlna dia Israel suante'n ahon tawi uh thilpiak tengteng Mosi a pan alata uhi. Huchi in zingsang teng in ut thu apiak thillatte akiang ah hon tawi uhi.
Mun siangthou a nna tengteng sem, khutsiam teng a nasep chiat a pan ahong pai ua,
Mosi kiang ah, "TOUPA'N bawl dia ahon thupiak bang a nasepna dia poimoh zah sang a tamzaw mite'n ahon tawi uh," achi uhi.

Mosi in thu apia a, giahphual teng ah atangkoupih ua, "Pasal hileh numei hileh mun siangthou bawlna dia thilpiak kuamah in pe nawn kei un," achi hi. Huchi in thilpiak hon tawi nawn lou dia kham in a-omta uhi.
Mun siangthou bawlna a nna tengteng sepna ding in avan neihsa uh kiching in, atam lota hi.
Nasemte lak a khutsiamte'n biakbuk khuhna ding siamtak a khui cherubte lim tuanna puanzak sawm, khau dum, khau sandup leh khau san-au khuk in abawl uhi.
heading: TOUPA Omna Puanin Bawlna / (Eks 26.1-37)

paite: Puanzak khat dunglam tong sawmnih-le-giat ahi a; availam tong li; puanzak tengteng letdan akikim chiat hi.
Puanzak ngate kithuah in akhep uhi. Puanzak dang ngate leng akhep hi.
Akithuahna mong khepna a pan puanzak khat gei ah khau dum in abilte abawl a, huchi mah in anihna khepna ah, puanzak dang gei chin ah abilte abawl hi.
Puanzak khat ah abil sawmnga abawl a, anihna kikhepna a puanzak gei ah abil sawmnga abawl hi. Abilte kizawn geihgeih in a-om uhi.
Dangka-eng in kilhna sawmnga abawl a, kilhnate in puanzakte agawmkhawm hi. Huchi in biakbuk khat ahong hita hi.
Puanin biakbuk tung a ding in kel mul in puanzak abawl a; sawm-le-khat abawl hi.
Puanzak khat dunglam tong sawmthum ahi a, puanzak khat vailam tong li ahi. Puanzak sawm-le-khatte alehlam akibang vek hi.
Puanzak ngate amau in akikheptuam a, puanzak gukte amau in akikheptuam hi.
Akikhepna puanzak mongchin ah abil sawmnga abawl a, puanzak anihna thuahna pen mong ah abil sawmnga abawl hi.
Khat ahihtheihna dia puanin kaihkhawmna ding in dal in kilhna sawmnga abawl hi.
Puanin khuhna ding in belampa vun diahsan in abawl a, huai tung ah ngalvang vun in khuhna abawl hi.
Singgi sing in biakbuk singpek ding atunthoh in abawl hi.
Singpek sau lam tong sawm ahi a, singpek zatlam tong khat-le-akim ahi.
Singpek khat in atgek nih anei a, akigamlatdan uh kikim in huchibang in biakbuk singpek tengteng a ding in abawl hi.
Biakbuk a ding in singpek abawl a, simlam pang a ding in singpek sawmnih abawl hi.

Singpek sawmnih nuai ah dangka-eng in kingakna khuakkuak sawmli abawl a; a-atgek nihte a ding in singpek khat dang ah kingakna khuakkuak nih, a-atgek nih a ding in singpek dang ah kingakna khuakkuak nih abawl hi.
Biakbuk pang khat lam a ding in, amallam ning a om a ding in singpek sawmnih,
adangka-eng kingakna khuakkuak sawmlite toh; singpek khat dang ah kingakna khuakkuak nih, singpek dang khat ah kingakna khuakkuak nih abawl hi.
Tumlam biakbuk pangte a ding in singpek nih abawl hi.
Apang nihte ah biakbuk ningte a ding in singpek nih abawl hi.
Anuai ah akithuah ua, atung ah sikkual khat ah akikaikhawm a; huchibang in aning tuak ah ahih tuaktuak hi.
Singpek giat a-om a; akingakna khuakkuak uh, dangka a bawl kingakna khuakkuak sawm-le-guk ahi ua, singpek chih dang ah kingakna khuakkuak nih abawl hi.
Singgi sing chiangtawn abawl a, biakbuk pang khat a singpekte a ding in nga abawl hi.
Biakbuk pang dang a singpekte a ding in chiangtawn nga abawl a, tumlam pang a biakbuk singpekte a ding in chiangtawn nga abawl hi.
Chiangtawn laita pen singpekte khat a pan adang kap paisuak in abawl hi.
Singpekte dangka-eng in aluan a, adangka-eng sikkualte chiangtawn omna ding in abawl a, chiangtawnte dangka-eng in aluan hi.
Khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat koptah hoih in puankhai abawl a; khutsiamtak in cherubte abawl hi.
Singgi sing in khuam li abawl a; dangka-eng in aluan a, abannate dangka-eng abawl hi. Huaite a ding in dangka in kingakna khuakkuak li asung hi.
Biakbuk kongkhak a ding in khau dum, khau sandup, khau san-au leh puanmalngat hoih koptah, phim a khui in puankhai abawl hi.
Akhuam ngate abanna uh toh; azingte uleh apuanduangte dangka-eng in aluan a, himahleh akingakna khuakkuak ngate dal a bawl ahi.
